name: AirPlay

policy._this_is_a_policy: What to assume when the device has said nothing - not a measurement. A record that knows its own real figure wins.

note: A HARD ceiling, and the one network protocol that changes Auto's answer rather than constraining it: AirPlay carries 44.1 kHz / 16-bit lossless and nothing more. Upsampling into it is work thrown away - whatever the module computes is resampled back down before it leaves. Auto should say so plainly instead of computing a setting the transport will undo. Figures for AirPlay 1; reports differ on whether AirPlay 2 reaches 48 kHz, and the difference does not change the conclusion.
